name: Scoriaceous-Tarn
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
